name: Daniela Ioana Alexandru
headline: Industry Director, NetSuite EPM and Analytics (NSPB, NSAR, NSAW), Oracle NetSuite, EMEA UK
position: Presales Industry Director, NetSuite EPM and Analytics, EMEA UK
about:
Currently working as a pre-sales Industry Director at Oracle Netsuite for EPM and Analytics: NSPB (NetSuite Planning and Budgeting), NSAR (NetSuite Account Reconciliation), NSAW (NetSuite Analytics Warehouse). I leverage my knowledge and practical experience in helping customers automate, stream-line, optimise and efficiently use ML/AI in their FP&A and BI processes.

Deep and extensive experience in the multiple facets of Business Intelligence and Business Performance Management projects using Oracle’s EPM suite and IBM’s Cognos suite. With a record of successful implementations for a vast portfolio of clients spanning telco, retail, industry, fashion, financial services, education, exhibition and catering. Involved in project governance and management (waterfall and agile frameworks), solution and innovation roadmap and all phases of a project lifecycle: bid & proposal, proof of concepts, solution design and modelling, solution build, documentation, training. Aligned with the business strategy, contribute to the company’s and team’s mission through strong professional vitality, positive attitude and delivering value. Excellent team coaching and junior training by setting highly effective learning environments suitable for knowledge sharing and professional growing.

Education: 
Ph.D. in Business Intelligence (2009)
M.S.in Informatics Systems for Management (2002)
B.S.in Economics Informatics (2001)
